lyrics.text: Three AM under the sodium light
Boxes come down and I sort them all night
Left is for blue and the right is for red
Mom's in the hospital, bills on the bed
In the neon hours I keep moving on
Nobody sees me from dusk until dawn
Sorting the pieces of somebody's life
In the neon hours I'm doing alright
Missed you on Sunday, I'm sorry, I know
Promise next week but it's always a no
Bus at the sunrise, my head on the glass
Watching the city go by way too fast
In the neon hours I keep moving on
Nobody sees me from dusk until dawn
Sorting the pieces of somebody's life
In the neon hours I'm doing alright
Keep moving, keep moving
Don't stop or you'll fall
Keep moving, keep moving
Don't stop at all
In the neon hours I keep moving on
Nobody sees me from dusk until dawn
Sorting the pieces of somebody's life
In the neon hours I'm doing alright
